cases.title: First lesson, no layer in mind: intent asked first; one candidate offered with a hinge; leave-outs named once

rubric.reason: Turn 1 asks "Which layer do you want to turn or grow from somewhere other than its middle? And where should it turn from: a corner, an edge, or the middle?" before the mentor names any place; Door's left edge is offered only in Turn 2.

After "I don't have a layer in mind", Turn 2 offers only Door with a hinge, "Door could swing from the middle of its left edge... Want to try that one?" This matches the snapshot proposal (Door, middle-left) and leaves room for another place or layer.
Turn 1 names only the relevant exclusions in short sentences: Wobble (anchor_keyed) and Seal (collapsed precomp it can't check). It says nothing about the Hatch Rig null and doesn't list every layer.
Title and Mentor Practice come from the learner record, and "two weeks ago" matches 2026-10-12 against today. Mentor Practice 2, Door, Wobble and Seal all appear in the anchor_snapshot result.

Both turns are a few short sentences, and each hands the learner a question: Turn 1 asks for a layer and a place, Turn 2 asks "Want to try that one?". The brief leave-out lines in Turn 1 are part of setting up the lesson, not a lecture.
